match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: Scarlett walks against the commuter flow as traffic begins rolling behind her. Framing: wide, eye level, Scarlett crosses through the center of a broad 16:9 street frame, surrounded by commuters, taxis, delivery bikes, and mirrored towers. Placement only, not the pose: Scarlett steps into the crowded crosswalk in a black-and-neutral outfit, carrying her tote with relaxed posture and coral lips as the bright focal point. Camera, as one or two arrows: truck, smooth. Characters: Scarlett, Female, 20s, A sharp-eyed young woman of medium height, A sleek black turtleneck with a streamlined black-and-neutral. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
